title: Fourth moment decomposition
statement: Let $d,e:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$ and $f:\\{-1,1\\}^{n+1}\\to\\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every sign $b\\in\\{-1,1\\}$ and every $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$, adjoining $b$ as the first coordinate gives $f(b,x)=b d(x)+e(x)$. Then $\\mathbb E[f^4]=\\mathbb E[d^4]+6\\mathbb E[d^2e^2]+\\mathbb E[e^4]$, where each expectation is uniform over the corresponding sign cube.
